Year by year
The Baillie Gifford Prize aims to reward the best of non-fiction and is open to authors of any nationality. It covers all non-fiction in the areas of current affairs, history, politics, science, sport, travel, biography, autobiography and the arts. Find out more about the history of the prize .
The 2026 Prize
We’re delighted to announce the judging panel for the 2026 Baillie Gifford Prize for Non-Fiction, and that the submissions process is now officially open to publishers.
